newsitem.title: USA: PECO Pa. Limerick 1 unit at reduced power.
newsitem.headline: PECO Pa. Limerick 1 unit at reduced power.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt Limerick 1 nuclear power plant was operating at 65 percent power early Monday for maintenance, the company said.

"The unit will be there until mid-week for some on-line maintenance on a hyrdraulic control unit," said company spokesman Michael Wood, adding its output would waver between 65 and 85 percent during this time.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at 98 percent power.
The Limerick power plant facility is in Pottstown, Pa.
